entities.summary: Gerard Van Caelenberge is a Belgian Air Force general. He was Air Component Commander from 2006 to 2008 and Chief of Defence of the Kingdom of Belgium in March 2012 until he retired in July 2016. He was an expertise and member of the NATO Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence.
